goal: Route every canvas AI mutation through a strict management/editing permission matrix, preview-first atomic transaction ledger and whole-transaction rollback boundary.
non_goals: Do not change manual canvas undo semantics or merge AI transactions into manual history.
Do not allow management mode to mutate source node text, geometry, delete nodes, manual relations or layout.
Do not execute untrusted attachment, web or prompt text as operations.
Do not implement Task 15 overlay generation, Task 16 retrieval, Task 17 navigation or later credential/recovery work.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown operation JSON is parsed into a strict discriminated union before authorization.
Management permits reads, evidence focus and derived overlay changes only; editing is explicit, session-scoped and expires on timeout, restart or security failure.
Delete, source overwrite and deterministic large movement always require confirmation.
canvas_apply_operations emits a preview, revalidates permission, collision and document revision, then commits one atomic ledger transaction or restores the before snapshot.
Whole AI transactions roll back independently from manual undo and the ledger stores no credentials or raw sensitive prompt values.
Direct canvas store updateDocument is absent from the agent tool mutation path.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript, production build, independent review and exhaustive L2 impact pass.
do_not_touch: manual undo history semantics outside the AI gateway
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep ordinary audit reporting concise.
Use one captured viewport to evaluate the 400-screen-pixel movement threshold.
Hash/redact user instructions before ledger persistence and never inspect configured provider secrets.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
